spec.context: Friday evening at a small neighborhood sushi restaurant with no reservations. One room: a kitchen where one chef works, four counter seats along the wall, and one table with four seats. People who cannot be seated wait by the door, where they can see every seat, or leave and eat somewhere else.

nodes.name: Counter seats
nodes.about: Four seats in a row. You order piece by piece and are out in about half an hour. Regulars ask for these.

nodes.name: Table
nodes.about: The only table, with four seats, shared when the room is full. Slower and easier to talk at than the counter.

archetypes.name: Neighborhood regulars
archetypes.description: Live nearby and come most weeks. They know the chef and how long a seat usually takes.

archetypes.name: Date night
archetypes.description: Out for the evening with one other person and in no hurry once seated.

archetypes.name: Small groups and families
archetypes.description: Three or four people who want to sit together and talk.

archetypes.name: Walk-ins
archetypes.description: Passing by, hungry, with other places to eat on the same street.

minds.name: Hiro Tanabe
minds.bio: Has eaten at the counter every Friday for nine years and always takes the seat nearest the chef.
minds.personality: patient, loyal, a little possessive of his seat
minds.goal: His usual counter seat and a word with the chef
minds.social: brings up the restaurant with everyone at his office

minds.name: Ana Ferreira
minds.bio: Nurse who lives upstairs and stops in after a twelve-hour shift, still in scrubs.
minds.personality: worn out, kind, cannot stand for long tonight
minds.goal: To sit down and eat something good before she falls asleep
minds.social: tells her building's group chat when the wait is bad

minds.name: Walter Brandt
minds.bio: Widower who used to come here with his wife on Fridays and still does.
minds.goal: A quiet dinner in the place they always came to
minds.social: chats with whoever sits next to him

minds.name: Maya Okafor
minds.bio: On a third date and chose this place herself after reading about it.
minds.personality: nervous, wants the evening to go well, embarrassed by waiting
minds.goal: A table where the two of them can actually talk
minds.social: will text her sister how it went

minds.name: Julian Reyes
minds.bio: Tenth anniversary tonight. The babysitter leaves at nine.
minds.personality: romantic, watching the clock, hates feeling rushed
minds.goal: One unhurried dinner with his wife

minds.name: Claire Dubois
minds.bio: Brought her two children after a swim meet. The younger one is hungry and close to tears.
minds.personality: practical, protective, out of patience by evening
minds.goal: All three of them fed at one table, soon
minds.social: talks to the other swim parents

minds.name: Sam Whitfield
minds.bio: Meeting two college friends who are in town for one night only.
minds.personality: easygoing, cares more about the company than the food
minds.goal: Somewhere the three of them can sit together
minds.social: the group decides together by text

minds.name: Priya Menon
minds.bio: Has a film starting at 7:30 a few blocks away and has not eaten since breakfast.
minds.goal: A fast dinner that does not make her miss the film

minds.name: Tom Gallagher
minds.bio: In town for a conference, eating alone, and curious about the place because the line looked like a good sign.
minds.personality: curious, patient when alone, likes watching a chef work
minds.goal: One memorable meal on an otherwise dull trip

minds.name: Dana Kowalski
minds.bio: Student treating herself after her last exam, with about forty dollars to spend.
minds.personality: excited, careful with money, easily put off by a crowd
minds.goal: A small celebration she can afford
